name: @jev-harness/vscode
description: TypeSafe Jev (System One) decisions inline in VS Code — destructive-change gate and RAG verification gate, fail-open by design.

commands.title: jev: review active file for destructive changes
jev: verify selection as a claim

jev-harness.apiKey.markdownDescription: TypeSafe API key. Falls back to `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`. Without a key the commands are fail-open and only explain.

jev-harness.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Jev base URL. Point at a proxy if your network requires it.

jev-harness.threshold.markdownDescription: Destructive-gate threshold. 0.5 is tuned on the labeled golden dataset.
